intelligence.human_view: A pilot doesn't fly by the flight plan; she flies by the instruments and the window. The plan said the weather would be clear — that's a claim. The window shows the cloud — that's the fact. And when the gauge and the window disagree, she believes the window and gets the gauge fixed. Every note in this family is somebody learning to look out the window.
intelligence.simple_view: Some news is so big you run and tell everyone right away. Some news can wait for the family dinner. And some isn't news at all. This system has a score that decides which is which — so nobody has to guess. And nobody ever opens anybody else's letters. Ever. That's not a rule you can switch off; the letters just can't be opened.
intelligence.grandma_view: A family is like that too: one family, shared table, shared stories — and still, you don't open your sister's letters. Togetherness was never the same as no boundaries. It's good to see a computer system finally written that way round.
intelligence.naya_view: Score before routing, and record the score with the note. Enforce the permission model in the gate matrix, not in prose. Never propose a toggle for the never-read rule. When a save is claimed, prove it across a reload in a real browser. Carry audit scores unflinching — 6/10 filed beats 9/10 claimed.
